address: C. Colón 384, Zona Centro, Guadalajara, 44100, Mexico
bio: From the tile floors and tile-lined walls to walls hung with pots and pottery, Birriería las 9 Esquinas has simple, rustic charm down pat. If the name didn't offer a hint, this longstanding restaurant is all about birria, specifically goat birria (the stained-glass goat's head enhancing one side of the kitchen is another clue). It is offered in a variety of ways here, with a standard order, a small order and an order of three tacos in freshly made corn tortillas. Their tortillas are skillfully made and cooked to order, and the birria is accompanied by a variety of salsas, as well as diced onion and lime for an enjoyable, casual meal you won't soon forget.
